changelog: The position tool is now the trade's ONLY on-chart visual, never hidden: previously, Place Trade hid the drawing and substituted a separate box that grew from the fill bar to the replay cursor on every Next Bar ('the candlesticks are going along with the risk:reward tool'). The linked drawing now stays visible the whole time -- pending, open, and after close -- fixed at the width the trader drew it (still stretchable via the v3.22.5 edge handles). The full-width Entry/SL/TP lines + $ pills, the Open P&L pill, the pending-order x cancel, and the closed-trade exit marker are all unchanged from v3.22.3.

State colouring on the linked drawing: pending (normal opacity, dashed orange entry edge), open (solid blue entry edge, Open P&L pill centred inside the box), closed (faded to 40% opacity, the exit marker carries the outcome).

Prices locked while live: while the linked order/trade is pending or open, entry/SL/TP can't be dragged (changing a live order isn't supported) -- enforced at hit-testing itself, including against the box's own 'move' drag, which previously shifted price along with time. The box can still be moved in time and stretched left/right. A lock icon shows in the toolbar; Place Trade and the R:R lock are dropped once a drawing is placed (re-submitting from an already-live or already-closed box doesn't make sense), and Delete is disabled while live.
New Trade from the sidebar with no drawing selected/drawn now auto-creates a real, linked, fixed 20-bar box at the fill bar -- every trade has one, not just ones started from a hand-drawn tool.

Fixed two related latent bugs found while building this: New Trade's own fallback search for a reusable drawing checked `!d._linkedTrade`, a property nothing in this codebase ever actually set, so it matched EVERY position drawing including ones already linked to a live order -- a second New Trade could have hijacked an already-placed trade's own box. Both of New Trade's lookup paths (the selected drawing, and the fallback search) now use the real link state. Also fixed: btSubmitTicket() closed the order ticket's UI before its own session refresh completed, a pre-existing race this release's own extra await (creating the new auto-linked drawing) made newly reproducible -- refresh now happens before the ticket closes, not after.
release_notes: No schema change this release -- db_migrations is empty, deploy is Update Now + a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), no backup or migrate.php step needed. New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3227.mjs (26 assertions) covers the full 5-item verify checklist against the stateful mock session 20 -- a Limit order's box staying identical across its own fill, New Trade's own 20-bar auto-creation, a TP close fading the box while it stays on the chart, 20 Next Bar steps leaving the box's own time span and on-screen width unchanged, and the lock itself proven directly via btHitTestOne() (not a flaky pixel-perfect mouse drag) alongside a real mouse-driven move+stretch to confirm those still work. drive.mjs and drive-v3226.mjs pass unmodified; drive-v3223.mjs and drive-v3225.mjs each needed one small, clearly-commented update where their own prior subject matter (the old growing box, and a since-freed drawing's own reuse priority) was directly superseded by this release, not a regression in what those releases actually shipped. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Renumbering per this briefing: session results/statistics is v3.22.8, the risk-ladder engine (previously slated as v3.22.7) is now v3.22.9, and the gate checklist is v3.23.0.
